description: Rocket Pool's v1.5 development branch on Hardhat 3, running the TypeScript integration suite that its `npm test` runs under hardhat-test.config.ts. The branch is under active development, so the pinned commit will need refreshing.

reset files & cache.command: git checkout -- test-solidity/util/LinkedListStorage.t.sol test-solidity/node/RocketNodeDeposit.t.sol contracts/interface/RocketStorageInterface.sol && npx hardhat clean --config hardhat-test.config.ts

edit & compile Solidity test with min de.command: printf "\n// hardhat benchmark edit\n" >> test-solidity/util/LinkedListStorage.t.sol && npx hardhat compile --config hardhat-test.config.ts

edit & compile Solidity test with max de.command: printf "\n// hardhat benchmark edit\n" >> test-solidity/node/RocketNodeDeposit.t.sol && npx hardhat compile --config hardhat-test.config.ts

edit & compile Solidity contract: contra.command: printf "\n// hardhat benchmark edit\n" >> contracts/interface/RocketStorageInterface.sol && npx hardhat compile --config hardhat-test.config.ts
